stops.name: Arrival and Welcome Series
stops.description: Landing triggers the first message in a five-part welcome series, delivered in person by a man holding a sign. Open rates are expected to be high, as he is standing right there.

stops.name: Hotel Check-In and Segmentation
stops.description: Guests are segmented by room type, floor, and tolerance for ocean-view upsells. Expansion revenue begins at the minibar.

stops.name: Lunch on the Lanai
stops.description: Seating has been arranged so the best view sits above the fold. Anyone placed below it may scroll.

stops.name: Lei-Making Workshop
stops.description: Teams string plumeria and orchids into leis, a hands-on lesson in nurture. Like any onboarding drip, each lei is slow, fragrant, and prone to tangling.

stops.name: Sunset Pipeline Review
stops.description: The forecast will be reviewed at sunset, ideal lighting for any number that needs to look warm. Pipeline is measured in coconuts, and coverage is currently described as generous.

stops.name: Wireframe Yoga
stops.description: Participants hold poses drawn in low fidelity. Downward dog will be rendered in grayscale until approved.

stops.name: Snorkeling and Net Revenue Retention
stops.description: Everyone is counted entering the water and again on exit. Anyone drifting toward open water will be classified as churn and gently re-engaged by a lifeguard.

stops.name: Botanical Garden Tour
stops.description: A guide introduces the hibiscus, the bird of paradise, and a plumeria tree that blooms without a single nurture email. Questions are welcome, but the tree will not be taking any.

stops.name: Shave Ice A/B Test
stops.description: Group A receives lime and Group B receives mango. Statistical significance is reached when someone says "the orange one" and nobody corrects them.

stops.name: Publish Day at the Beach
stops.description: Teams build a sandcastle, publish it at low tide, and verify its breakpoints against the incoming wave. Rollback is automatic.

stops.name: Luau and Quarterly Business Review
stops.description: Dinner doubles as a quarterly review of the roast pig, which has been in the oven since the previous quarter. Slides are optional; napkins are not.

stops.name: Farewell Brunch
stops.description: The buffet is organized like a sitemap: eggs to the left, pastries to the right, and a table of untouched melon that returns a 404.

stops.name: Waterfall Hike
stops.description: The trail loads slowly but rewards patience. Load times are measured in switchbacks, and the view is considered a strong above-average experience.

stops.name: Souvenir Shop Win-Back Campaign
stops.description: Anyone who abandoned a snack in their cart on Day 1 will receive a win-back offer: a second chance and a magnet.

stops.name: Hibiscus Tea and Annual Review
stops.description: Annual recurring revenue will be discussed over hibiscus tea, in annual recurring pineapples. Please direct questions to the suggestion box, which is shaped like a lei.

stops.name: Lei Exchange
stops.description: Each attendee gives one lei and receives one, a perfectly balanced trade and the only forecast this week with no variance.
